name: Pope Leo XIV
quote: The doctors believe it's best to take action, so, following their advice, I've decided to have surgery to remove it. (Angelus, Oct 11, 2026, as reported by CBS News)

name: Holy See Press Office
quote: The surgery was successful, and there were no complications. (Vatican bulletin, as reported by CBS News)

name: Giorgia Meloni
quote: Expressed personal support and that of the Italian government to Leo, calling his calm manner in discussing the surgery reassuring. (paraphrase, AP via Boston Globe, Oct 11)

name: Dr. Stefano Margaritora
role: Chief thoracic surgeon, Gemelli; led the surgical team
quote: No direct quote published; the Vatican said the team removed the lower lobe of the right lung by video-assisted surgery to ensure a radical resection. (CBS News)

name: Candida Moss
quote: The Vatican tends to keep these things under wraps (paraphrased from CBS News analysis, Oct 13)
